predecessors.name: Principality of Lucca and Piombino
predecessors.text: Lucca, formed in 1815 'out of the former Republic of Lucca and the Principality of Lucca and Piombino'

successors.name: Grand Duchy of Tuscany
successors.text: Lucca, reverted to Tuscany on 17 December 1847

rulers.name: Maria Luisa of Bourbon, Infanta of Spain
rulers.title: Duchess

ledger.x: 9 June 1815: the Congress of Vienna creates the Duchy of Lucca.
17 December 1847: the Duchy of Lucca reverts to Tuscany.

certainty.note: A Congress of Vienna creation inside the old republic's borders; the page gives no frontier text and no territorial exchange, and the Tuscan exchanges of 1847 (Lunigiana) are in the Tuscany dossier, not on this page.
